description: Reports the CookiePal account this client is signed in as: the user, the organisation, the domain tools act on by default, and each domain’s plan and whether its page-view limit has been reached. Use it to confirm a connection, or to find out which domain other tools will use when none is given.

domain.description: The domain to report on. Defaults to the organisation’s current one.

name: whoami

domainPlans.description: Each domain this user can see, with its plan and whether this month’s page-view limit has been reached. Plans are per domain, not per account.

title: Show the connected CookiePal account
